title: Arista Networks Q2 2026 financial results
excerpt: Revenue was $3.036 billion, up 37.7% year over year; GAAP operating margin was 45.4%; third-quarter revenue guidance was approximately $3.3 billion.
summary: Q2 results exceeded the revenue run-rate embedded in the prior sensitivity and raised the next-quarter revenue baseline, while preserving strong profitability and making the prior valuation inputs stale.
